latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Free Unrestricted.

- Instantly convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC images (up to 50MB) into 10-second animated videos—no paywalls or content restrictions.
- Seamless automatic setup: connects to the cloud backend, acquires free credits, manages user session, and confirms readiness.
- Simple workflow: upload images, describe the desired animation, and receive a downloadable 1080p MP4 within 20–40 seconds.
- Supports batch processing, timeline editing with video, audio, and text overlays, and easy export options.
- Detailed API error handling, helpful prompts, and robust fallback for missing credits or unsupported files.
